rules.name: auth_owner
rules.why: only the owner changes the owner

rules.name: init_once
rules.expr: ok and pre("initialized") != 0 and post("initialized") != pre("initialized")
rules.why: initialisation can't be undone or redone

rules.name: exec_owner
rules.expr: called("execute") and ok and sender != pre("owner")

rules.name: exec_paid
rules.expr: called("execute") and ok and post("paidOut", arg(0)) != pre("paidOut", arg(0)) + arg(1)

rules.name: conserved
rules.expr: ok and post_sum("paidOut") + post("balance") != pre_sum("paidOut") + pre("balance")
rules.why: money is neither created nor destroyed

rules.name: exec_works
rules.why: the owner can always spend what's there
